title: Standing-Order Months per Line by Age of the Subscription (PAP Supply Replenishment Program)
content:
**Rule.** The months a standing-order cushion line of the Self-Pay Supply Subscription covers in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program are set by how long ago the subscription was opened:

| Subscription opened (whole calendar months from the enrollment date to the handling day) | Months a standing-order line covers |
|---|---|
| fewer than 12 | one month |
| 12 to 23 | two months |
| 24 or more | no shortening under this rule |

In words: one month for a subscription opened less than 12 months ago, two for one opened 12 to 23 months ago.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, handling day 8 September)

- Opened 9 September of the previous year: 11 whole months, one month.
- Opened 8 September of the previous year: 12 whole months, two months.
- Opened 9 September two years earlier: 23 whole months, two months.
- Opened 8 September two years earlier: 24 whole months, no shortening under this rule.
